name: tcommit-certificate-transport
cmd: set -euo pipefail; root=$PWD; out=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; export PATH="$root/scripts/lean-gate:$PATH"; mkdir -p "$out/rechecked"; sha256sum transport-retained/Proofs.lean > "$out/retained-source.sha256"; export LEAN_PATH="$out/rechecked:$root/transport-retained/.lake/build/lib/lean"; lean -o "$out/rechecked/Proofs.olean" transport-retained/Proofs.lean > "$out/retained-check.log" 2>&1; lean research/bapa/TCommitCertificateTransport.lean 2>&1 | tee "$out/transport.log"; cp research/bapa/TCommitCertificateTransport.lean "$out/TCommitCertificateTransport.lean"
